qs.q: A company wants to ensure that data stored in Amazon S3 is encrypted at rest using keys fully managed by AWS, with no customer-managed key configuration, no per-key access policies, and no AWS KMS audit trail. Which encryption option should they use?
qs.e:
SSE-S3 uses Amazon S3 managed keys (AES-256) with no customer involvement, no per-key policies, and no KMS audit trail.
SSE-KMS uses AWS KMS keys (AWS-managed or customer-managed) and adds KMS access policies and CloudTrail integration, which is more than the requirement asks for. SSE-C requires the customer to provide and manage their own keys on every request. Client-side encryption happens before upload and is fully customer-managed.

qs.q: Which AWS service provides a managed hardware security module (HSM) for cryptographic key storage?
qs.e: AWS CloudHSM provides dedicated HSM instances. KMS is a managed key service but uses shared infrastructure. Secrets Manager stores secrets, not HSM keys. ACM manages SSL/TLS certificates.

qs.q: A solutions architect needs to restrict access to an S3 bucket so that only a specific IAM role can access it. What should they configure?
o: S3 bucket policy with a Condition element
qs.e: A bucket policy with a Condition element can restrict access to a specific IAM role ARN. ACLs are legacy and less precise. Object Lock prevents deletion. Versioning preserves object versions.

qs.q: Which feature of Amazon VPC allows you to monitor network traffic flowing to and from network interfaces?
qs.e: VPC Flow Logs capture information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC. VPC Peering connects VPCs. NAT Gateway enables outbound internet for private subnets. Internet Gateway connects a VPC to the internet.

qs.q: A company requires all API calls to AWS services to be logged for compliance. Which service should they enable?
qs.e: AWS CloudTrail records API calls made to AWS services. CloudWatch monitors metrics and logs. AWS Config tracks resource configurations. GuardDuty is a threat detection service.

qs.q: A web application must remain available even if an entire Availability Zone fails. Which architecture pattern achieves this?
o: Deploy to a single AZ with Auto Scaling
Deploy across multiple AZs with an Application Load Balancer
Deploy to a single AZ with a larger instance type
Deploy to a single Region with CloudFront
qs.e: Multi-AZ deployment with an ALB distributes traffic across AZs, providing resilience against a single AZ failure. A single AZ deployment, regardless of scaling or instance size, cannot survive an AZ outage.

qs.q: Which Amazon RDS feature provides automatic failover to a standby replica in a different Availability Zone?
qs.e: Multi-AZ deployment maintains a synchronous standby replica in a different AZ with automatic failover. Read Replicas are for read scaling, not automatic failover. Aurora Serverless auto-scales capacity. RDS Proxy manages database connections.

qs.q: A company needs to decouple their application components to handle variable processing loads. Which service should they use?
qs.e: Amazon SQS is a fully managed message queuing service that decouples application components. RDS is a database service. EC2 is a compute service. S3 is object storage.

qs.q: Which S3 storage class should be used for data that is accessed less than once per quarter and can tolerate retrieval times of 12 hours?
qs.e: Glacier Deep Archive is the lowest-cost storage class, suitable for data accessed rarely with retrieval times of 12-48 hours. Glacier Instant Retrieval provides millisecond access. One Zone-IA stores data in one AZ.

qs.q: An application uses Amazon DynamoDB and must be able to recover from accidental table deletion. Which feature should be enabled?
qs.e: Point-in-time recovery allows continuous backups of DynamoDB tables and restoration to any point in the last 35 days. Streams captures table changes. DAX is an in-memory cache. Global tables provide multi-region replication.

qs.q: A company needs to serve static content to users worldwide with low latency. Which AWS service should they use?
qs.e: CloudFront is a CDN that caches content at edge locations worldwide for low-latency delivery. Global Accelerator improves availability and performance for dynamic content. Route 53 is a DNS service. EC2 is a compute service.

qs.q: Which service should be used to run containers without managing servers or clusters?
qs.e: AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers that removes the need to manage servers. ECS on EC2 requires managing EC2 instances. Elastic Beanstalk is a PaaS for web applications.

qs.q: An application requires sub-millisecond read latency for a DynamoDB table. Which feature should a solutions architect recommend?
qs.e: DAX is an in-memory cache for DynamoDB that provides microsecond read latency. Streams captures changes. Global tables provide multi-region replication. On-demand capacity auto-scales throughput.

qs.q: A company needs to process real-time streaming data from IoT sensors. Which service should they use?
qs.e: Kinesis Data Streams is designed for real-time streaming data ingestion and processing. SQS is for message queuing. SNS is for pub/sub notifications. Amazon MQ is a managed message broker.

qs.q: Which AWS service provides a fully managed, highly available, and scalable file storage for use with EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones?
qs.e: Amazon EFS provides scalable, elastic file storage accessible from multiple EC2 instances across AZs. EBS is block storage attached to a single instance. S3 is object storage. Storage Gateway connects on-premises to AWS storage.

qs.q: A company wants to reduce EC2 costs for workloads that can tolerate interruptions. Which purchasing option should they use?
qs.e: Spot Instances offer up to 90% discount but can be interrupted. On-Demand has no discount. Reserved Instances require commitment. Dedicated Hosts provide physical server isolation.

qs.q: Which AWS service helps identify underutilized resources and provides cost optimization recommendations?
qs.e: Trusted Advisor inspects your AWS environment and provides recommendations for cost optimization, security, performance, and fault tolerance. Cost Explorer visualizes costs. Budgets sets alerts. Pricing Calculator estimates costs.

qs.q: A company runs a development environment that is only used during business hours. Which approach minimizes costs?
o: Use On-Demand Instances and stop them after hours
qs.e: Stopping On-Demand instances when not in use eliminates compute charges (only storage costs remain). Reserved Instances are for steady-state workloads. Spot Instances can be interrupted. Dedicated Hosts are expensive.

qs.q: Which S3 feature can automatically move objects to cheaper storage classes based on access patterns?
qs.e: S3 Lifecycle policies automatically transition objects between storage classes or expire them based on rules. Versioning preserves object versions. Replication copies objects across buckets. Object Lock prevents deletion.

qs.q: A solutions architect needs to choose between Amazon RDS and Amazon DynamoDB. Which factor most favours DynamoDB?
o: Consistent single-digit millisecond latency at any scale
qs.e: DynamoDB provides consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. RDS is better for complex SQL queries, multi-table ACID transactions, and schema enforcement.
